_README.purpose: HAND-AUTHORED capability policy. Never generated. Observation can see which tables and columns an operation touches; it cannot see coverage semantics, integrity rules, availability policy or receipt ownership. Deriving those produced a constant ('observed-available') and a string built from the first emitted table, both presented as contract.
rules: Keys are capability ids from capability-registry.json, verbatim.
An entry must state all of coverage, integrity, availability, receiptOwner. null means 'not yet authored' and is explicit, not a placeholder.
evidence must cite what the value rests on: a file:line, a production observation with its date, or a spec section.
A capability authorizes nothing until all four fields are non-null (authorizationEligible in the registry). Partial authoring is recorded but buys no authority.
Entries beginning with _ are documentation and are ignored.
